title: Home
what: Amplify helps young people across the UK turn the issues they care about into change through Parliament and public life. It brings together campaign planning, trusted official sources, safeguarding and help in one place, with no sign-up and nothing collected about you.
for: It is for young people aged 11 to 18 (and up to 25 with SEND), Members of Youth Parliament, and the parents, carers, teachers and youth workers who back them.

steps.d: Take a guided tour for your role, or open the campaign hub.
